verdict.rationale: Requesty documents building with the official OpenAI SDK by changing its base_url to the Requesty router. Its API reference also provides generated Python and TypeScript samples. It explicitly offers no first-party client of its own ("no new client to learn"), so SDK support comes through compatibility rather than Requesty-maintained SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party Requesty SDKs (published packages, versioning, language coverage), SDK coverage of the management API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
